item.g:title: Firehorse Automation
item.g:description:
Firehorse Automation

Price: Custom Quote Includes: Analysis of manual bottlenecks, implementation of 3 core automation workflows, and operational dashboard setup.

Description

Part of the Firehorse Flexible Toolbox.

Powerful automation tools to streamline repetitive tasks and integrate your systems. It removes the human bottleneck from your compliance and operational pipelines.

Why Firehorse Automation?

Speed is Compliance. "Fit for 55" reporting cycles are tightening. Manual data entry is too slow and error-prone. If your report is late or wrong because of a typo, it costs millions in penalties. It is serious marketing with penalty if not done properly.

At the end of the project, your critical data flows from sensor to report without human touch.

Zero-Touch Compliance Methodology

"Eliminate the copy-paste." Firehorse Automation targets the "swivel chair" integration where humans move data between systems: * Orchestration: Connects DWS IQ, ERP, and IoT. * Error Handling: Intelligently manages API failures or bad data. * Auditability: Every step of the automation is logged.

Usage Scenario: The Broken Sensor

A critical flow meter fails on the factory floor.

Firehorse Automation handles the incident: 1. Detect: The Ingestion Workflow notices the data stream has stopped. 2. Alert: It creates a maintenance ticket in your ERP (e.g., SAP PM). 3. Mitigate: It flags the data gap in DWS IQ and applies the approved "estimation method" for compliance reporting (flagging it as estimated). 4. Report: It adds an incident note to the Monthly Report. 5. Outcome: Compliance continuity is maintained, and maintenance is dispatched instantly.

Expected Impact & Efficiency

  • Elimination of manual entry errors
    • How: Machine-to-machine integration.
  • Real-time incident response
    • How: Instant alerts replacing manual checks.
  • Reduced operational overhead
    • How: Freeing staff from repetitive tasks.

The 5 Firehorse Automation Agents

  1. Workflow Runner: Executes the defined automation logic.
  2. Exception Handler: Manages errors and retries.
  3. Connector Agent: Maintains API sessions with external systems.
  4. Schedule Monitor: Ensures time-based jobs run correctly.
  5. Optimization Scout: Suggests performance improvements for workflows.

Technical Specifications

  • Engine: Event-driven Serverless Functions.
  • Connectivity: REST, SOAP, MQTT, SQL.
  • Reliability: 99.9% Uptime SLA.

References

  • McKinsey & Company. The automation imperative.

item.g:title: Lifetime DWS IQ Platform (Version 6)
item.g:description:
Lifetime DWS IQ Platform (Version 6)

Price: Starting from €4,999 (Standard Deployment) Includes: DWS IQ Base deployed in your cloud, one Firehorse Report use case, and standard SAP/ERP integration connectors.

Description

The Industrial "Brain" for Fit for 55 Compliance.

DWS IQ is an AI‑native platform we deploy to your cloud to automate the reports and decisions your team currently builds manually. It serves as the single source of truth for your operational and climate data.

Why DWS IQ 6?

The Foundation for Carbon Credit Integrity. Fit for 55 compliance isn't optional. It's an existential risk (penalties) and a massive opportunity (Carbon Credits). You can't manage what you don't measure. DWS IQ 6 provides the audit-grade data foundation. It is serious marketing with penalty if not done properly.

At the end of the deployment, you own an audit-proof data foundation running in your own cloud.

The Industrial Brain in Your Cloud

"How do I ensure data sovereignty?" Unlike generic SaaS, DWS IQ 6 runs in your cloud environment with clear cost and ownership. * Validation: We don't just store data; we validate it against regulatory standards. * Ownership: You own the data, the model, and the infrastructure. * Context: Pre-trained on industrial verticals (Logistics, Construction, Manufacturing).

Usage Scenario: The Fit for 55 Audit

Your annual ESG audit is due in 4 weeks.

DWS IQ runs the validation loop for you: 1. Ingest: It pulls raw operational data from SAP, Fleet Systems, and Energy Meters. 2. Validate: The Data Validator Agent checks for gaps, anomalies, or "impossible" values (e.g., negative fuel consumption). 3. Calculate: It applies the latest EU ETS carbon formulas to the validated data. 4. Trace: Every number is linked back to its source transaction (Audit Trail). 5. Outcome: You hand the auditor a login to a read-only "Audit Room" where every claim is verified. You pass with zero stress and zero spreadsheets.

Expected Impact & Efficiency

  • 100% Audit Readiness
    • How: continuous validation means you are always ready for an unannounced inspection.
  • 30-50% reduction in data prep time¹
    • How: Automating the ETL (Extract, Transform, Load) process from silos to the IQ core.
  • Total Data Sovereignty
    • How: Running in your private cloud means no vendor lock-in and full GDPR compliance.

The 5 DWS IQ Agents

  1. Data Validator: Checks incoming streams for quality and consistency.
  2. Compliance Monitor: Tracks real-time performance against EU regulations (ETS, CSRD).
  3. Integration Agent: Manages secure connections to SAP, ERP, and IoT devices.
  4. Security Guardian: Enforces NIS2-compliant access controls and encryption.
  5. Orchestrator: Manages the flow of data between the Core and Firehorse apps.

Technical Specifications

  • Deployment: Google Cloud Run, Azure Private Link, or On-Premises.
  • Integration: Standard connectors for SAP S/4HANA, Microsoft Dynamics, Salesforce.
  • Security: NIS2 Compliant, Encryption at Rest and in Transit.
  • Architecture: Event-Driven Microservices (Python/FastAPI).

References

¹ Gartner. (2023). Data Management for the AI Era. (Estimates automation reduces data preparation overhead by 40%). * EU Commission. (2023). Fit for 55 Package Legislation.

item.g:title: Lifetime DWS IQ Platform (Version 5)
item.g:description:
Lifetime DWS IQ Platform (Version 5)

Price: Legacy Support (Contact Sales) Includes: Assessment of legacy infrastructure, support for existing DWS IQ 5 instances, and a migration path consultation.

Description

Legacy / Alternative Tier.

The proven precursor to DWS IQ 6, supporting established industrial workflows. It remains a robust choice for specific legacy environments.

Why DWS IQ 5?

The Compliance Bridge. For organizations not yet ready for the full AI-native DWS IQ 6, Version 5 provides a stable bridge to "Fit for 55" compliance. It ensures you aren't left behind as reporting requirements tighten. It is serious marketing with penalty if not done properly.

At the end of the day, it keeps your legacy operations compliant while you plan for the future.

The Bridge Methodology

"Stabilize then Modernize." DWS IQ 5 focuses on stability and connectivity for older industrial protocols: * Compatibility: Native support for older OPC-UA and Modbus versions. * Stability: Proven, monolithic architecture. * Path Forward: Built-in data exporters to migrate easily to IQ 6.

Usage Scenario: The Retrofit Factory

A factory runs on 15-year-old PLCs and cannot support edge AI.

DWS IQ 5 secures the data: 1. Connect: It utilizes legacy drivers to poll the PLCs. 2. Buffer: It stores data locally to handle unstable internet connections. 3. Report: It generates standard CSV reports for the central office. 4. Outcome: The factory participates in the corporate carbon reporting without a hardware overhaul.

Expected Impact & Efficiency

  • Extended asset life
    • How: Connecting legacy machines to modern reporting.
  • Risk mitigation
    • How: Ensuring older sites aren't compliance blind spots.

The 5 DWS IQ 5 Components

  1. Legacy Poller: Reads data from older industrial protocols.
  2. Local Buffer: Ensures data integrity during outages.
  3. Sync Engine: Uploads data to the cloud when available.
  4. Report Generator: Basic template-based reporting.
  5. Migration Agent: Tools to assist in moving to IQ 6.

Technical Specifications

  • Architecture: Monolithic .NET/Java application.
  • Protocols: Modbus, OPC-DA, CSV import.
  • Requirements: Windows Server 2016+ or Linux.

References

  • Lifetime Technical Support. DWS IQ 5 End of Life Policy.

item.g:title: Firehorse™ Omnichannel Next
item.g:description:
Firehorse™ Omnichannel Next

Price: €499.00 / campaign cycle Includes: one 4‑week test cycle, setup workshop, and final recommendations session.

Description

The Launch Command Center for Sustainable Products.

Firehorse Omnichannel is a specialized AI marketing engine designed to launch "Green" and "Regulatory" products in the EU. It doesn't just buy ads; it finds the specific decision-makers (Sustainability Directors, CFOs) who are currently searching for compliance solutions, and delivers your message across LinkedIn, Google, and Email with zero waste.

Why Firehorse Omnichannel?

Green Launches Have Zero Margin for Error. Most product launches fail because they spend 80% of the budget finding the audience. Firehorse flips this: we use regulatory data (who needs to report CSRD?) to define the audience first, then spend your budget only on high-probability targets.

Outcome: At the end of a 4‑week cycle, you know exactly which channels and messages deliver qualified leads, validated by data, not guesswork.

Market Focus Optimization

"Where should I target my €2,000 budget?" Firehorse solves the "Allocation Problem". Instead of guessing, our AI agents analyze real-time signal data to split your budget dynamically. * Budget Allocation: Automatically shifts funds from low-performing channels (e.g., broad Google Ads) to high-performing ones (e.g., niche LinkedIn groups) every 24 hours. * Penalty Avoidance: Ensures all marketing claims are checked against the EU Green Claims Directive to prevent "Greenwashing" accusations.

Usage Scenario: The €2,000 Test Launch

You want to launch a new sustainable product with a €2,000 test budget. Firehorse Omnichannel runs the validation loop for you: 1. Deployment: It splits your budget across 2–3 high-potential channels (e.g., €800 LinkedIn, €800 Google, €400 niche/community). 2. Analysis: The Marketing Optimization Controller tracks engagement, cost per click, and lead quality signals. 3. Optimization: Within 48 hours, it detects that LinkedIn is driving ESG leads while Google is underperforming. 4. Action: It recommends shifting budget to the best-performing segments. 5. Outcome: You get a ranked view of channels by cost-per-qualified-lead.

EU Compliance & Regulation Features

Built for the Era of the AI Act and DSA. Marketing in the EU is no longer the Wild West. Firehorse Omnichannel ensures your campaigns are safe and compliant by design:

  • EU AI Act Transparency: Automatically tags AI-generated content and chatbots as "Automated System" to meet transparency obligations.
  • Green Claims Directive: The "Greenwashing Guard" agent scans your ad copy against EU taxonomy standards to flag risky claims (e.g., "Eco-friendly" without proof) before you publish.
  • GDPR & ePrivacy: Built-in consent management for tracking pixels and data collection. We do not store PII without explicit opt-in.
  • DSA (Digital Services Act): Adherence to ad transparency rules for online platforms.

Expected Impact & Efficiency

  • 15-80% Reduction in Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC)¹
    • How: Stopping spend on "ghost" audiences who don't have the regulatory pain you solve.
  • 30-200% Increase in Qualified Pipeline²
    • How: Targeting by "Regulatory Need" (Must-have) rather than "Interest" (Nice-to-have).
  • Zero Regulatory Risk
    • How: Pre-flight compliance checks prevent costly legal mistakes.

The 5 Firehorse Agents

  1. Campaign Strategist: Plans the budget allocation.
  2. Content Creator: Generates compliant ad copy and assets.
  3. Compliance Officer: Checks for Greenwashing and GDPR risks.
  4. Channel Optimizer: Adjusts bids in real-time.
  5. Analytics Reporter: Generates the "Truth" report.

Technical Specifications

  • Integrations: LinkedIn Ads API, Google Ads API, HubSpot, Salesforce.
  • Compliance Engine: EU Taxonomy Database, AI Act Rulebook.
  • Hosting: Private Cloud (Data stays in EU).

References

¹ McKinsey & Company. (2021). The Future of B2B Sales. (AI-driven targeting efficiency). ² Boston Consulting Group (BCG). (2023). AI in Marketing: From Hype to Impact

item.g:title: Firehorse Report
item.g:description:
Firehorse Report

Price: €1,999 Includes: One automated report template, SAP integration setup, and a 4-week validation cycle.

Description

Automated reporting on top of DWS IQ.

Firehorse Report turns the reports your team builds manually into automated, AI‑native outputs in a few weeks. It plugs into SAP/your existing tools, is tailored to your exact format, and usually ends up cheaper than your current SaaS + internal labour combined.

Why Firehorse Report?

Serious Marketing with Penalties. EU mid‑size industrial, logistics, and construction companies now face strict reporting duties: Fit for 55, EU ETS, CSRD, EPBD. These rules all end up in the annual report. Getting these numbers wrong means real penalties and blocked access to ESG capital.

At the end of a 4-week cycle, your critical board pack is automated and audit-ready.

The Last Mile Automation

"Why can't my BI tool do this?" Generic BI tools visualize data, but they don't produce compliance-ready documents. Firehorse Report focuses on the Last Mile: * Exact Format: We output to the exact PPT/PDF/Excel template your board expects. * Narrative Generation: AI writes the "Why" behind the numbers, not just the charts. * Traceability: Click on any number in the PDF to see the source data in DWS IQ.

Usage Scenario: The Monthly Board Pack

Your team spends 5 days a month building the Climate KPI Board Pack.

Firehorse Report automates the workflow: 1. Trigger: On the 1st of the month, the Report Agent wakes up. 2. Fetch: It queries DWS IQ for the verified emissions and operational data. 3. Generate: It populates your specific PowerPoint template, updating charts and text placeholders. 4. Review: It sends a draft to the sustainability officer via Teams/Slack. 5. Outcome: The officer reviews the draft in 15 minutes, approves it, and it's distributed. 5 days of work becomes 15 minutes.

Expected Impact & Efficiency

  • 90% reduction in reporting man-hours¹
    • How: Eliminating manual copy-pasting and formatting.
  • Elimination of transcription errors
    • How: Direct machine-to-machine data flow.
  • Faster decision cycles
    • How: Reports are available on Day 1, not Day 10.

The 5 Firehorse Report Agents

  1. Report Generator: Assembles the final document (PPT, PDF, Excel).
  2. Data Fetcher: Retrieves specific metrics from the DWS IQ core.
  3. Visualizer: Generates compliance-standard charts and graphs.
  4. Template Matcher: Ensures the output perfectly matches your corporate branding.
  5. Audit Logger: Records exactly when and how the report was generated.

Technical Specifications

  • Outputs: PowerPoint (.pptx), Excel (.xlsx), PDF, HTML.
  • Integrations: DWS IQ Core, Microsoft 365, Google Workspace.
  • Delivery: Email, Slack, Teams, SharePoint.

References

¹ McKinsey & Company. (2024). The economic potential of generative AI. (Highlights 50-75% productivity gains in document generation tasks).

item.g:title: Firehorse Content Management
item.g:description:
Firehorse Content Management

Price: Custom Quote Includes: Secure Evidence Vault setup, Taxonomy design workshop, and initial data migration.

Description

Part of the Firehorse Flexible Toolbox.

A flexible content management solution designed to streamline your digital asset workflows and compliance evidence. It serves as the secure repository for the proofs behind your claims.

Why Firehorse Content Management?

The Evidence Vault for Your Year Book. Every carbon credit claim needs proof. Certificates, audit logs, and reports need a secure, organized home to feed into your Annual Report. Missing documentation means failed audits and penalties.

At the end of the deployment, every green claim you make is one click away from its source proof.

Evidence Vault Methodology

"Where is that certificate?" Stop digging through email chains. Firehorse Content Management treats compliance documents as critical assets: * Auto-Tagging: AI reads your documents and tags them by regulation (e.g., #EU-ETS, #Scope3). * Expiration Watch: Alerts you before a critical green certificate expires. * Linkage: Connects the document directly to the data point in DWS IQ.

Usage Scenario: The Unannounced Audit

An auditor demands proof of renewable energy sourcing for Q3.

Firehorse Content Management executes the retrieval: 1. Search: You type "Energy Certificates Q3" into the vault. 2. Retrieve: The Search Agent finds the 3 PDFs provided by your utility provider. 3. Verify: It shows the metadata linking these files to the Q3 Carbon Report. 4. Share: You generate a secure, temporary link for the auditor. 5. Outcome: The auditor validates the claim in minutes. No panic, no lost files.

Expected Impact & Efficiency

  • Zero lost compliance documents
    • How: Centralized, immutable storage.
  • 50% faster audit response times
    • How: Instant retrieval via semantic search.
  • Proactive compliance
    • How: Automated expiration alerts prevent lapses.

The 5 Firehorse Content Agents

  1. Document Classifier: AI that reads and categorizes uploads automatically.
  2. Expiration Tracker: Monitors dates and sends renewal alerts.
  3. Search Agent: Finds documents based on natural language queries.
  4. Access Controller: Manages permissions and secure sharing.
  5. Archive Manager: Handles retention policies and secure deletion.

Technical Specifications

  • Storage: Secure Cloud Storage (Encryption at Rest).
  • Search: Vector-based Semantic Search.
  • Format Support: PDF, Docx, JPG, PNG, CAD.
  • Compliance: GDPR-ready data retention workflows.

References

  • ISO 27001. Information Security Management Standards.

item.g:title: Expert Advisory & Implementation
item.g:description:

Price: Retainers from €1,500 / month | Kickoff Package €3,000 Includes: Dedicated expert time to design reports, tune models, and align the Lifetime platform with your processes.

Layer 3 of the Lifetime Offer Stack.

While DWS IQ provides the platform and Firehorse provides the automation, our Expert Services ensure these tools drive maximum value for your specific business context. We don't just support the software; we support your transformation.

Why Expert Services?

"AI is a tool. Strategy is human." Fit for 55 compliance and AI-driven marketing require more than just code. They require process re-engineering. Our experts bridge the gap between your legacy operations and the AI-native future, ensuring you don't just "install" the software, but actually "evolve" the business.

At the end of the engagement, your team isn't just using AI—they are mastering it.

The Kickoff Package

Price: €3,000 (One-off) The Foundation for Success. Before we automate, we validate. This package ensures your DWS IQ deployment is scoped correctly from Day 1. * DWS IQ Base Workshop: Deep dive into your data sources and compliance needs. * Scoping: Detailed roadmap for 2–3 Firehorse use cases (e.g., Report Automation + Marketing Launch). * Support: Includes your first month of "Standard" support.

Monthly Retainer Tiers

Continuous Value Engineering. Choose the level of engagement that fits your transformation speed.

1. Standard Retainer

Price: €1,500 / month Focus: Maintenance & Tuning * Hours: ~10 hours/month. * Scope: Designing new simple reports, tuning existing agent prompts, monthly compliance check-in. * Ideal for: Stable operations needing steady optimization.

2. Growth Retainer

Price: €3,000 / month Focus: Active Development * Hours: ~20-25 hours/month. * Scope: Building custom agents, deep ERP integration support, weekly strategy sessions. * Ideal for: Companies actively rolling out new Firehorse modules.

3. Transformation Partner

Price: Custom (Starting from €5,000 / month) Focus: Full Strategic Alignment * Scope: Embedded advisory, custom R&D, "fractional CAIO" (Chief AI Officer) support. * Ideal for: Large enterprises undergoing total digital transformation.

Usage Scenario: The "Fit for 55" Sprint

You need to align your entire supply chain reporting in 3 months.

Expert Services orchestrates the sprint: 1. Month 1 (Kickoff): We map your data gaps and configure DWS IQ. 2. Month 2 (Growth Retainer): We build custom connectors for your non-standard logistics vendors. 3. Month 3 (Standard Retainer): We tune the automated reports based on auditor feedback. 4. Outcome: You pass the audit with a system that runs itself.

Expected Impact & Efficiency

  • Faster Time-to-Value
    • How: Experts bypass common configuration pitfalls.

Technical Specifications

  • Delivery: Remote (Teams/Zoom) + On-site workshops (optional).

  • Response Time: Priority SLA for Retainer tiers.

References

  • Lifetime Services. Service Level Agreement (SLA).
